aboutGame.title: What is Dead of Darkness 2?
paragraphs: Dead of Darkness 2 is the sequel to Dead of Darkness (2025), developed and self-published on PC by solo studio Retrofiction Games. The story opens in rural Pennsylvania in 1985, where Jun Takehara lives a quiet life in a trailer deep in the Appalachians with her old friend Felton.

After Jun finds a wounded, memoryless girl in the woods, two suspicious policemen arrive and the night collapses into a nightmare tied to the town of Goldren Creek. Rebuilt in an isometric 2D view, the sequel leans into classic survival horror: scarce ammo, a weight-limited inventory, crafting, puzzles, and switching between up to three characters.

faq.title: Dead of Darkness 2 FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Dead of Darkness 2.

items.question: What is Dead of Darkness 2?
items.answer: Dead of Darkness 2 is an isometric 2D survival horror game from Retrofiction Games. It is the sequel to Dead of Darkness (2025) and follows Jun Takehara and Felton through the mystery of Goldren Creek in rural Pennsylvania, 1985.

items.question: When does Dead of Darkness 2 release?
items.answer: No release date has been announced yet. Dead of Darkness 2 is listed as to be announced on Steam and GOG, where you can wishlist it for launch updates.

items.question: What platforms is Dead of Darkness 2 on?
items.answer: Dead of Darkness 2 is confirmed for PC on Steam and GOG, plus PS5, PS4, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch, with eastasiasoft handling the console ports.

items.question: Can you switch characters in Dead of Darkness 2?
items.answer: Yes. Dead of Darkness 2 lets you switch between up to three characters in certain sections, and the developers use that mechanic for puzzles, sharing gear through a shared item box, and escaping enemies.

items.question: Is there co-op or multiplayer in Dead of Darkness 2?
items.answer: No. Dead of Darkness 2 is a single-player survival horror game, so there is no co-op or multiplayer mode.

items.question: How should beginners start Dead of Darkness 2?
items.answer: Read our Dead of Darkness 2 beginner guide: learn your inventory and combine buttons, keep a light core kit, finish weakened enemies with a knife, and bank one panic medkit for scripted encounters.
